summary: Reviewed all 78 occurrences. Preserve active1 relocation, active2 bridal conveyance and independent Detransitive1 marriage. Readers' D2 and statements that a Detransitive gloss is absent are contradicted by the entry.
Bridal conveyance can precede formal marriage: PrS35/106 and112 distinguish it from mhərulle and being a wife; 113/149 describes the later ceremony. No new generic 'marry' sense is needed.
ḥəwolo has nominal ritual-event syntax throughout; use Nomen Actionis conservatively. Active Imperativ and both active and Detransitive Infectum-wa are supported.
Indefinite plural mḥawlulle is active, despite impersonal German translations. l-NPs may mark agents (Osman), beneficiaries (son), or bride object (105/75).
Hospital EL43/Hors1/43 and AA/OA /104 are already represented; no duplicate addition. Allowed lookup of ḥwy1 confirmed the competing hospital accommodation entry.
29/59 mḥawle under latne permits a result-state Part. Pass. reading but overlaps finite Detransitive Preterit; no new box published on this ambiguity.

Jan Beṯ-Şawoce: the supplied English is project machine translation, not an edition translation. All semantic decisions rest on the Turoyo; quoted English is copied from the supplied machine translation.

The modern prose supplies an attempt meaning with d- event complements. Reader comparison to Arabic ḥāwala is a plausible etymological hypothesis, not evidence to rewrite the inherited Form-II transfer etymology or assign a new Turoyo stem.

Existing bridal sense2 and Detransitive marriage1 remain distinct. Round 1 already fills active Preterit2 and Infectum2 to five and introduces active Infectum-wa; readers' absence claims no longer apply.
Maḥwəlanwole, Mḥawlowa and Mḥawlowalle do not by themselves establish three clean -wa examples. Their source vowel order and agent/patient coding are retained in the decisions and questions.

Currency conversion changes denomination; legal transfer changes ownership under a name. These differ from physical referral, while the legal construction is kept as a subsense of1 rather than an unrelated meaning.
